description: .env file parser and linter — Parse a .env / dotenv file into JSON the way dotenv and docker compose read it: comments, export prefixes, single/double quotes, escapes, multi-line quoted values, inline # comments, ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} references (expand=true to resolve them from earlier keys). Lints it: invalid or shell-unsafe key names, duplicates, spaces around =, unquoted values with spaces, unterminated quotes, empty values, undefined references. Flags secret-looking keys and values (API keys, tokens, passwords, credentialed URLs) and masks them by default (mask=none to return values, mask=all to mask everything). Verdict VALID / VALID WITH WARNINGS / INVALID. Pass text= or url= of a raw file. Offline. JSON. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_env_parse
